'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Thomas E. Whatley LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Thomas E. Whatley]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet player name also appears as Whaley; published as Thomas E. Whatley. Deck title White Meat. Sheet marks one Qui-Gon With Lightsaber as (V); no wiki (V) title — published as three [[Qui-Gon Jinn With Lightsaber]].


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Thomas E. Whatley]]

* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|Quiet Mining Colony]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
